entries.title: Your first mate takes you to the exact place in Settings
entries.body: Ask your first mate to connect your phone, change a computer's address, move your first mate, keep a copy on another computer, sign a computer in to GitHub, forget a kept job or open a page of Secrets, and its card takes you straight there, where the last click stays yours. On your computer, it can also open a task's record or a Settings section when you ask to see it. Asking it to turn on the Infinitary command now opens that switch, not a server key form.

picture.alt: The first mate's Connect your phone card with its Make a link button
